steps.what: Record license numbers and observed details of vehicles disregarding traffic signals
Check observed facts and report infractions to the appropriate authorities

tasks.design: Test an approved native {WORKFLOW} incident form to capture observations once for the authority's report. Keep direct plate observation, factual checking and the decision to report with the guard; no camera recognition or automated infraction judgement is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Handwritten observations may need rewriting into an official report.
tasks.enabler_now: A simple approved form can preserve the original entry and assemble the required fields.
tasks.still_hard: A partially seen license number cannot safely be completed by inference.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish what was actually observed from uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated recording where duplicate transcription exists.

evidence.claim: An approved incident form may reduce repeated transcription; the digest supplies no crossing-guard capability or measured result.

assumptions: Boundary is guard recording and reporting, excluding authority investigation or enforcement.

Guard produces directly observed license characters, time, location, signal observation and uncertainty during s1's52 retained hours. No structured plate, infraction code or trusted automated observation is assumed.
Missing characters remain explicitly unknown; the report cannot infer them. All final factual checking and reporting remain35 hours in s2.
Test the authority's existing form and accepted reporting route before custom code. Capture occurs only when it does not interfere with the guard's traffic duty.
unknowns: Authority reporting fields and accepted digital channel
research_questions: Does one-entry capture reduce report time without changing observations or obscuring uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Observe and capture incident facts and uncertainty
Check facts and submit the report

incremental.description: Maintain accepted form fields and resolve capture issues
Maintain reporting access and destination settings

approvals.approved_version: Exact observed license characters, uncertainty, time, location, incident description and recipient; edits require renewed guard review

steps.what: Stop speeding vehicles and warn drivers of traffic laws within assigned authority

tasks.design: Retain authorised direct traffic intervention and warnings. Existing instructions in {DOCS} define local duties; no automated vehicle stopping or enforcement is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Traffic intervention requires immediate situational judgement and appropriate authority.
tasks.still_hard: Responding within role limits in changing traffic conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Assess the situation and communicate clearly.

evidence.claim: The design retains direct warnings and makes no claim about legal stopping powers or automated enforcement capability.

assumptions: Boundary is the guard's locally authorised intervention; duties and powers vary by assignment and jurisdiction.
Guard observes the situation directly during the retained step; no measured speed or structured violation flag is assumed.
No new software configuration or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which situations require escalation rather than direct intervention under the local assignment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; direct intervention and warning remain.

steps.what: Learn the location of street traffic signs in assigned patrol areas
Learn the purpose of the signs and clarify unfamiliar arrangements

tasks.design: Retain direct area familiarisation and learning of current guidance in {DOCS}. A map or summary does not establish that the guard has learned the actual location and purpose.
tasks.previous_blocker: Local knowledge requires relating guidance to the real street arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing guidance supports the unchanged learning.
tasks.human_edge: Connect the sign's purpose with the actual patrol context.

evidence.claim: Local familiarisation and learning remain fully counted, with no map-automation saving assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is guard learning, excluding creation and maintenance of traffic signs or official maps.
Guard observes actual signs in s1 and reads current guidance in s2; no complete structured sign inventory is assumed.
No new tool or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which local arrangements need explanation before the guard can work confidently?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; actual familiarisation and learning remain.

steps.what: Discuss traffic routing plans and control-point locations with superiors

tasks.design: Retain direct discussion using the current plan in {DOCS}. No automatic routing or control-point selection is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plan understanding depends on local observations and clarification.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing plans support the unchanged discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving uncertainties about the actual street and control location.
tasks.human_edge: Raise practical concerns and confirm the agreed instructions.

evidence.claim: Direct routing discussion remains fully counted; the digest supplies no capability that replaces it.

assumptions: Boundary is discussion of an existing plan, excluding supervisor plan design and guard implementation.
Supervisor produces the current plan through the existing process; guard supplies observations directly during the retained conversation.
No new structured capture, system configuration or upkeep.
research_questions: What practical uncertainty must be resolved before the guard follows the assignment?
